name: Sparkline
description:
A single-series line that fills its box: smooth (monotone, no overshoot), 2px whatever
the size, a wash of the data colour beneath and a ringed dot on the latest point. Pure SVG + CSS; the
plot is inset by the dot's radius so nothing is ever cut off at the edges.
signature: ({ data, domain, tone, area, dot, hover, onHover, reference, thresholds, label, className, ...rest }: SparklineProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: data
props.description: Typed records rendered by the component.

props.name: domain
props.description: Fixed value range (e.g. [0, 100] for percentages). Defaults to the data's range.

props.name: dot
props.description: The ringed dot on the latest point.

props.name: hover
props.description: Index under the crosshair; null hides it. Controlled by the parent (Metric).

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible summary. Omit when a parent already describes the chart.

props.name: onHover
props.description: Turn on pointer hit-testing; called with the nearest index, or null on leave.

props.name: reference
props.description: A horizontal hairline at this value (e.g. the average).

props.name: thresholds
props.description:
Hairlines at values in their tone (a warning limit, a target). Without a fixed `domain`
the range grows to include them, so a line is never pinned to an edge. They carry no
label: name what they mean in `label` or beside the sparkline.

props.name: tone
props.description: Line colour: the data colour, or a status tone only when the series is in that state.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
